displayName: Extract and screen CVs from your inbox
summary: Summarise every applicant's fit against your job description automatically.

useCases.title: Extract and screen CVs from your inbox
useCases.message: Help me screen incoming job applications. Ask me which role I'm hiring for. If you don't already know where applications come in and what system I use to track candidates, ask. Then go through each application, extract the CV, summarise how each candidate's background compares to the job description, and add the results to wherever I track candidates.
